title: Could Virgil van Dijk stop the running of the bulls?
caption: Could Virgil van Dijk stop the running of the bulls? 50 games, nobody got past him. 🐂🧱 #could #vandijk #liverpool #pamplona #football #shorts #fyp

scenes.text: Could Virgil {Van Dijk|Van Dyke} stop the running of the bulls?
{{pam}}Pamplona. ||0.17|| {{six}}Six bulls. ||0.17|| {{ton}}Over half a ton each. ||0.2|| {{run}}Everyone runs.
{{vvd}}{Van Dijk|Van Dyke} doesn't run. ||0.25|| {{fifty}}Fifty Premier League games. ||0.17|| {{nobody}}Nobody dribbled past him.
{{one}}Bull one. ||0.2|| {{show}}He shows it outside. ||0.3|| {{fence}}Into the fence.
{{two}}Bulls two and three try a one-two. ||0.25|| {{step}}He just steps in between.
{{five}}Five bulls. ||0.17|| {{zero}}Zero dribbles. ||0.3|| {{six}}Then comes bull number six. ||0.4|| {{name}}Its name: ||0.3|| {{pepe}}{Pépé|Peh-peh}.
{{y19}}In {2019|twenty nineteen}, Nicolas {Pépé|Peh-peh} ended that record. ||0.3|| {{never}}Some things never change.
